main_text.p: nostrum grabe, Belg. graf & grabe, se-pulchrum. Lucus etiam nobis grobe, de quo Spelman. noster, in voce graba.
Gnollihe, & gnlltke, Gloria : & alibi gnoltchetne. vide gnoltcan] Sax. pul-oop, & pulope, gloria, pulooplic, glo-riofus.
main_text.head: Verba.
main_text.p: Gebaltbon, Irritaverunt. vide Balgon] Belgon potius, & Abalgt.
Geberfoes, Coronafti : Et alibi gerinlf, coronat, itemque gereboffo, coronafti] Vide supra garo.
Gebirmon, quiescere : gebirmeba, quievit : gebirme, quiescam. Ungebirmlich, Incessabilis.
Gelicoba, Complacui. vide Lfcont] Complacere, Sax. zelicean : nobis hodie to lihe : complacui autem, eis ic zelicoba ; nobis hodie 3 lkeb.
Gefuogan, Adjicies] Saxon. foz, & zefoz item foozinz, Junctura, con-junctio.
Getobotoliban, Obriguerunt] Pri-ori vocis parti affine nostratium tonab, Sax. toh, id est, tenax, lentus, quibus lentum vimen, tohzaepo ?

page.notes: Black-letter and Old German words are rendered approximately; several glosses are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. Greek and Old Saxon forms are only approximate.
